property_summary: For any non-negative ether amount sent by a tx.origin player after the contract is open and before any wager by that player, the wager() call succeeds only when msg.value equals the owner-set betLimit (0.5 ETH here), so the recorded player's wager equals exactly betLimit; the mutant also accepts msg.value > betLimit and records an oversized wager.
change_summary: Changed the wager amount check from equality with betLimit to msg.value being greater than or equal to betLimit.
